label: Cold NVMe microscopy reads: chunks, blocks, and codecs

context.storage: Local PCIe NVMe array; file cache verified cold before each batch

source.attribution: Fred Ausubel's laboratory, Massachusetts General Hospital; Broad Bioimage Benchmark Collection, Ljosa and colleagues, Nature Methods (2012).
source.changes: Selected well C05 brightfield TIFF from the version 2 image archive and repacked the complete decoded image as little-endian uint16 without rescaling.

source.attribution: Alexandr A. Kalinin and colleagues, DynaCell team, Computational Imaging Group at Biohub, led by Shalin B. Mehta.
source.changes: Selected one full reconstructed Phase3D plane from the mock A549 condition, field fov0006, time index 0, Z index 24, and repacked the released float32 values without rescaling. No prediction or segmentation channels are included.

source.attribution: CellMap Project Team, HHMI Janelia Research Campus; Melanie Freeman, Harald Hess, David P. Hoffman, Andrew Moore, H. Amalia Pasolli, Gleb Shtengel and C. Shan Xu. Interphase COS-7 dataset: https://figshare.com/articles/dataset/24898086.
source.changes: Selected 32 depth planes at Z=896,898,...,958, Y=2048:3072 and X=3840:4864 from reconstruction 1, full-resolution s0. Repacked the published uint8 values without rescaling, interpolation, filtering, averaging, or denoising. The leading axis follows depth through one specimen.

acquisition.modality: focused ion beam scanning electron microscopy (FIB-SEM)

reconstruction.processing: Provider-reconstructed and aligned uint8 volume. Earlier intensity conversion and other processing details are not established by the array metadata. Grid spacing describes this reconstruction, not a verified physical milling pitch; the current Figshare record links reconstruction 2 with a different grid.
